author: reek
body: Proves the pilot holds counterspells instead of wasting them. A Counterspell cast at sorcery speed into an empty main-phase stack counters nothing, so find-best-spell must not pick it: with only a Counterspell in hand it declines to cast (returns -1, holding for the response window); with a creature also in hand it casts the creature. Before this the greedy caster threw counters into the void, which is why the control archetype could not win.
